gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-arimo: Wallpoet is bold and commanding, its lowercase climbing high with paper showing between letters. Arimo then settles into the text with rounded shapes and open gaps, so paragraphs go down without a snag.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-athiti: Commanding Wallpoet cuts its curves smooth and lets paper show between letters, with no stroke contrast at all. Athiti handles the friendlier work, keeping each s open and its single-width line sign-shop simple.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Bold, smooth-curved Wallpoet lets paper show between its letters and lifts its lowercase high. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono is the approachable one, with open counters, and Wallpoet does its best work big and short.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-biryani: Smooth, loud and sliced with paper-white gaps: that's Wallpoet. Biryani, a sans-serif body, draws one steady stroke with a wide eye on every e, and Wallpoet is happiest big and short.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-carrois-gothic: Wallpoet commands the page with smooth bends and a hairline of paper between letters. Carrois Gothic, a modern sans with a generous opening in its c, keeps paragraphs moving without strain.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Carrois Gothic SC reads with a clear opening at the end of every curve and little gap between capital and lowercase height. Let Wallpoet go large up top; it is bold and commanding.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-comme: Smooth bends, high lowercase, daylight between letters: that's Wallpoet. Comme, modern through and through, fills most of the letter height with its lowercase and reads smoothly, paragraph after paragraph, with no clogged curves.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-cossette-texte: Commanding curves with daylight between the letters: that's Wallpoet. Cossette Texte supplies smooth, tube-like lines and a prominent x-height, giving the Wallpoet heading a clean companion to sit with.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-gafata: Gafata sets a wide-eyed lowercase e inside a deep band of letters with short stalks above, beneath a commanding Wallpoet heading. Over a full page it reads smoothly, with a contemporary, businesslike feel.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-hind-guntur: Loud meets steady: the high lowercase of Wallpoet against the single-weight, cable-like line of Hind Guntur. Wide gaps beside the stems keep the sans-serif body moving, line by line.
